app.name: Accrue
app.tagline: Put your dollars and NIM to work, and check that your pool really pays.
onboarding.title: Your money at work, in plain sight
onboarding.body: Accrue puts idle dollars into Aave on Polygon and helps you stake NIM with a pool that actually pays.
onboarding.noPromptYet: Nothing is asked of your wallet until you tap.
onboarding.nimHint: Reads your NIM balance and stake. Nimiq Pay asks you once.
onboarding.dollarsHint: Reads your USDT and USDC on Polygon. Nimiq Pay asks you once.
landing.title: Accrue lives inside Nimiq Pay
landing.body: Open it in the Nimiq Pay app to put your dollars and NIM to work.
error.USER_REJECTED: You cancelled in your wallet. Nothing was sent.
error.PROVIDER_MISSING: Open Accrue inside Nimiq Pay to use your wallet.
error.NETWORK: No connection right now. Check your internet and try again.
error.TIMEOUT: This took too long. Try again.
error.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME: We could not confirm whether this went through. Check your activity before trying again.
error.duplicatePayment: This transaction was already sent. Check your activity.
error.invalidTransaction: Nimiq Pay rejected this transaction as invalid. Nothing was sent.
error.updateWallet: Your version of Nimiq Pay does not support this yet. Update the app and try again.
error.wallet: Nimiq Pay could not finish this. Try again.
error.walletBusy: Your wallet already has a request open. Check Nimiq Pay.
error.chainUnavailable: Your wallet cannot switch to Polygon right now.
error.WRONG_CHAIN: Your wallet is on another network. Switch to Polygon first, then try again.
error.insufficientGas: Not enough POL to pay the network fee.
error.serviceDown: The Accrue service is not answering. Try again in a minute.
error.ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: This token is not supported. Use USDT or USDC on Polygon.
error.DEADLINE_INVALID: The signature expired. Sign again to continue.
error.BAD_SIGNATURE: The signature did not match. Sign again to continue.
error.PERMIT_NONCE_STALE: This approval was already used. Sign a fresh one to continue.
error.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your balance is too low for this amount.
error.RATE_LIMITED: You reached 10 free transactions in 24 hours. Try again later.
error.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Free gas is used up for today. You can pay the network fee yourself.
error.RELAYER_LOW_GAS: Free gas is paused right now. You can pay the network fee yourself.
error.SIMULATION_FAILED: This transaction would fail on Polygon, so it was not sent.
error.AAVE_LIQUIDITY: Aave cannot pay out this amount right now. Try a smaller amount or try later.
error.RPC_UNAVAILABLE: Polygon is not answering right now. Try again.
error.INTERNAL: Accrue hit a problem on its side. Try again.
nim.step.wait: Wait for the network to release it
nim.switch.deactivateFirst: To change pool, your stake first stops earning. Once the network releases it (up to about a day), one more tap moves it to the new pool.
nim.switch.direct: One tap moves your stake to {pool}.
nim.wait.resetsTimer: Stopping more now restarts the wait for the NIM that is already waiting.
nim.wait.noRewards: Stake that is waiting earns nothing.
nim.restake.suggestion: {amount} NIM is sitting idle. Staking it earns about {extra} NIM more a year.
nim.tx.pending: Sent. It can take a minute to show up here.
nim.error.BELOW_MINIMUM: Staking needs at least 100 NIM in total.
nim.error.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: You do not have that much NIM available.
nim.error.FUNDS_SPLIT: Only {amount} NIM can be staked right now: Nimiq Pay stakes from one account at a time, and the rest of your NIM sits in your other account.
nim.error.LEAVES_DUST: Leave at least 100 NIM staked, or unstake all of it. The network refuses anything in between.
nim.error.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount up to what you have staked.
nim.error.NOT_READY: This step is not ready yet. Wait for the countdown to finish.
nim.error.BUSY: Finish the open request in Nimiq Pay first.
nim.error.TX_FAILED: The network rejected this transaction, so your stake did not change.
dollars.error.pending: Your last transaction with this token is still on its way. Wait until it lands, then try again.
dollars.error.notDeployed: Dollar deposits are not open yet: the Accrue contract is not live on Polygon.
dollars.error.connectFirst: Connect your Polygon wallet first, then try again.
dollars.error.ownerHasCode: USDC cannot be moved with a signature from this kind of wallet. Use USDT instead.
verdict.PAID_AS_PROMISED.desc: Payouts arrived on schedule and matched what the fee allows, within 2 points.
verdict.BEHIND_SCHEDULE.desc: No payout for more than twice the published interval.
verdict.SHORT.desc: Over at least three payout cycles, stakers got more than 5 points less than the fee allows.
verdict.NOT_ENOUGH_DATA.desc: Fewer than three payout cycles in the window, or a result too close to call. We wait rather than guess.
verdict.NO_PAYOUTS_BY_DESIGN.desc: The pool lists no payouts, so nothing is owed and nothing is flagged.
verdict.CANT_VERIFY_ROUTED.desc: 30% or more of the rewards leave to addresses we can't tie to stakers, so we don't call it either way.
